text: Acceptance 14 (composer): after Enter sends, focus leaves the composer; next keystrokes go nowhere, ArrowUp-edit unreachable. Repro (anna, #general): click composer, type 'first', Enter, wait 2 s -> document.activeElement = BODY; type 'second' -> composer value ''; ArrowUp -> no inline edit. Cause: sendMessage calls widok.composer() (renderComposer, widok-czat.js:1128), which replaces the textarea without refocusing. Fix: focusComposer() after the re-render.
